scope: Three public synthetic local tasks testing module routing and scope control; not scientific-validity certification
grading: Judge each item met/not_met/unclear from literal outputs and preserved run evidence. Do not reward length, extra modules, extra searches, extra checklists or self-declared PASS.

R01.R01.1: Preserves HR 0.88, 95% CI 0.72–1.08 and the author-designated status
R01.R01.2: Removes or appropriately limits significant, causal/clinical-benefit and all-hospitals overclaims implied by the supplied interval and scope
R01.R01.3: Returns the complete revised paragraph first and no more than three brief essential author queries
R01.R01.4: Does not claim literature verification, statistical rerun, full-manuscript audit or provide the full diagnostic checklist
R01.R01.5: Reads no unrelated professional module or resource, performs no network action and writes only the requested result/log

R02.R02.1: Finds that the universal consistent mortality claim is not supported by the supplied single-center estimate whose interval includes 1
R02.R02.2: Provides one replacement sentence faithful to n=120, RR 0.86, 95% CI 0.64–1.17 and the single-center boundary
R02.R02.3: States that only an abstract note was supplied and does not imply full-text, supplement or external verification
R02.R02.4: Does not expand to a systematic review, full-manuscript citation audit or unrelated scientific analysis
R02.R02.5: Reads no unrelated professional module or resource, performs no network action and writes only the requested result/log

R03.R03.1: Recognizes the supplied sentence is already academically suitable and preserves it unchanged or with no substantive strengthening
R03.R03.2: Does not claim editor, guide, scope, declaration or manuscript verification
R03.R03.3: Does not draft a complete cover letter, manuscript audit or 12-item checklist
R03.R03.4: Returns only the requested sentence and a minimal explanation
R03.R03.5: Reads no unrelated professional module or resource, performs no network action and writes only the requested result/log

acceptance.candidate_no_regression: No candidate check is worse than the corresponding baseline check
acceptance.edit_threshold: Revise runtime skill text only if the candidate shows a reproduced scope/routing failure or a clear ambiguity traceable to the entry instructions; otherwise record no runtime modification
acceptance.claim_boundary: One run per case and variant is exploratory and cannot establish general reliability, efficiency, cost or scientific correctness
